informational.text: ds-chart draws the Unpin control while its category cursor is pinned, on its caption's line or, without a caption, over the top end of the plot. In every chart the .pin-reset button now sits inside an internal ds-chart-unpin element rendered display: contents, so a consumer rule selecting it as a direct child of the chart's figure no longer matches; select .pin-reset alone.
informational.verify: click a band of a ds-chart and confirm an Unpin pill appears at the top end of the chart, and that pressing it releases the cursor and removes the pill.
